body:
[A10] Assignment for #185 and #186 together (author [A647]). Branch `185-186-control-unlock` from processor main `08ae0013`. Both change the AECP engine's generated microcode, so one lane does them, in two commits.

1. **#185:** add a READ_DESCRIPTOR current-value overlay for CONTROL, as #82 did for ENTITY, AUDIO_UNIT, CLOCK_DOMAIN and STREAM_INPUT/OUTPUT. After every SET_CONTROL, `value_details` must carry the current value (IEEE 1722.1-2021 7.2.22, 7.3.6.2; Milan v1.2 5.3.12).
2. **#186:** the notification driven by a LOCK_ENTITY command echoes the command's flags, as the response does (IEEE 1722.1-2021 7.5.2, 7.4.2.1). The lock-timeout notification (Milan v1.2 Table 5.22) keeps flags 0.
3. Add suite cases for each, each with a planted mutant that fails it. Update docs/architecture/06_aecp_engine.md and the command records.
4. Run every processor gate at base and head: `scripts/run_suites.sh`, `lint_hdl.sh`, `make check`, `gen_matrix.py --check`, and `syn/yosys/run.sh` with the CI-pinned sv2v and Yosys. Run the parent consumer gates on a scratch parent at milan-fpga dev e9cbb676 with the gitlink set to your head, plus the parent patches `parent-evidence-classification.patch` (#180) and the milan_dp section #67 patch (#176).
5. STOP on any register-map, top-level port or parameter change.

Post REVIEW READY or STOP here.
